observation.sourceFootprint: Full photograph, rectified with calibrated WCS. No manual scale, rotation, or displacement.
observation.intensityMeaning: Rec.709-weighted encoded sRGB display signal; not linear radiance or a gas-density measurement.

prior.meaning: Trilinearly filtered encoded stellar support decoded after filtering, sampled on calibrated observer rays. Relative clipped/quantized density prior; no luminosities, dust, or measured star depths.

limitations: The native display composite determines angular positions and color; it is not calibrated flux.
The full photograph footprint is retained. This footprint does not cover the full stellar simulation or establish where gas lies outside the photograph.
Compact candidates are a morphological top-hat channel, not identified foreground stars. Their light is excluded from both compared cloud targets and shown separately.
The simulation provides approximate stellar depth support; fitted emission shapes and thickness are hypotheses, not measured gas or dust.
No arbitrary 3x photo fit or authored rotation is applied. The source density is unchanged.
Display emission only: no dust extinction or radiative transfer is recovered.
This pair renders only the extended morphological channel. The omitted compact candidates and diffuse remainder are shown separately; neither is asserted to be measured foreground light.
